items.title: Grainger (GWW) Stock May Be Fairly Valued As Cash Flow Keeps Pace
items.summary: W.W. Grainger has delivered very strong gains over the last five years, which puts a spotlight on whether the current US$1,255.69 share price is adequately supported by the cash the business can generate. For investors, the central issue now is how that market value lines up against the company’s long term cash flow potential. items.title: 5 Industrial Distributors With a Competitive Advantage Hiding in Plain Sight
items.summary: Some distributors are so deeply wired into their customers' factories and procurement systems that a cheaper rival barely registers as a threat. Five industrial companies have built that kind of grip, and their dividend histories reveal just how durable the cash flows behind it really are.

items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks Hiding in Boring Businesses Customers Cannot Live Without
items.summary: Some of the steadiest compounders in the market spend their days hauling trash, killing bugs, and stocking factory shelves, and their customers almost never leave. Here is why that kind of boring turns into decades of uninterrupted dividend raises.
